name: Code Review
description: 检查正确性、安全性与可维护性，输出可执行的修改建议。
install: Review the current diff. Prioritize bugs, security risks, and missing tests.
content: Review the current diff. Prioritize bugs, security risks, and missing tests.

name: Deep Research
description: 围绕问题收集来源、核对事实并整理结论。
install: Research the topic, compare primary sources, and cite every time-sensitive claim.
content: Research the topic, compare primary sources, and cite every time-sensitive claim.

name: Frontend Builder
description: 负责 React 界面实现、无障碍与浏览器验收。
install: Own frontend implementation and validate the critical journey in a real browser.
content: Own frontend implementation and validate the critical journey in a real browser.

name: Release Reviewer
description: 在交付前独立检查需求覆盖和回归风险。
install: Review the delivery against requirements and report only actionable findings.
content: Review the delivery against requirements and report only actionable findings.

name: Explain Simply
description: 把复杂技术主题改写成清晰、可执行的说明。
install: Explain {{topic}} in plain language. Include one concrete example and the main trade-off.
content: Explain {{topic}} in plain language. Include one concrete example and the main trade-off.

name: Meeting Summary
description: 从会议记录提取决定、负责人和后续行动。

content: Summarize the transcript into decisions, owners, deadlines, and unresolved questions.
